_comment: Example registry for relay/herdr_ops.py. The live copy belongs at
~/.config/herdr-remote/ops.json (or HERDR_OPS_CONFIG) — NOT in this repo, because it names
the binaries the bot is allowed to execute.
Everything herdr-ops can do to this machine is a row in 'services' or 'commands'.
There is no other path: no shell, no /exec, no free-form binary.
chat_ids: empty means every command is refused. Message the bot and it tells you your id.
A {placeholder} must be a WHOLE argv element. "-C{repo}" is rejected at load time.
Each param declares exactly one of enum / int / re; unvalidated input never reaches argv.
health: exactly one of tcp / pgrep / http / unit.
A service with neither 'start' nor 'unit' is monitor-only — visible to /health, not startable.
menu: groups entries behind one '/<menu>' command with a button per member, and takes them
off the top-level menu. They still work typed. label: the button text, defaults to the name.
A member with params cannot run from a button — there is nowhere to type them.
